name: Pi Web
description: Pi Web is a web UI for Pi Coding Agent that keeps agent sessions alive in real workspaces. Provides a browser-based interface to manage multiple Pi Coding Agent sessions, supervise runs, and work with real repositories from anywhere.

notes.text: Access Pi Web in your browser at http://<container-ip>:80.
Browser access has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
Config and session data is stored in ~/.config/pi-web/ and ~/.pi-web/.
